item.title: ROGAN RAVENHILL EXTENDS STAY AT OAKWELL
item.description: Barnsley FC is delighted to announce that goalkeeper Rogan Ravenhill has signed a new contract, keeping him at Oakwell until 2029, with a further year option in the Club’s favour. Ravenhill’s journey with Barnsley began at the age of seven, when he first joined the Club’s Academy system. item.title: BARRY COTTER DEPARTS OAKWELL
item.description: Barnsley Football Club can confirm that Barry Cotter has left the Club with immediate effect by mutual consent. We thank Barry for his contributions whilst in a Red shirt and wish him all the best for the future.

item.title: LEO FARRELL JOINS SCUNTHORPE UNITED ON LOAN
item.description: Barnsley Football Club can confirm that forward Leo Farrell has joined National League outfit Scunthorpe United on a 28-day youth loan. The 20-year-old will continue his development with the Irons at the Attis Arena, as Andy Butler's side compete at the top end of the division looking for a return to the EFL. Everyone at Oakwell wishes Leo the best of luck for the next month.
